title: Hawaii State Ethics Commission Informal Advisory Opinion IAO2020-01
text:
INFORMAL ADVISORY OPINION NO. 2020-1
The Commission received a complaint that a legislator allegedly threatened to
oppose a private organization’s legislative initiative unless the private organization
rescinded its endorsement of the legislator’s political opponent. The legislator, who is
no longer in office, denied that such a threat ever occurred. The Commission did not
hold a contested case hearing and did not make any findings as to whether the
allegations were substantiated. The Commission issued an Informal Advisory Opinion
to the former legislator, advising that the Fair Treatment law, Hawai‘i Revised Statutes
§ 84-13(a), would prohibit a legislator from attempting to seek a campaign endorsement
(or seeking the rescission of an endorsement of one’s opponent) by threatening to take
action as a legislator.
